description: Use this when the user asks for overdue items, past leftovers, missed tasks, unfinished items from previous days, or Czech “resty”. Calendar events are excluded.

householdId.description: Optional Familia household id. Omit to use all accessible households.

limit.description: Maximum number of past-due items to return. Defaults to 20.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Prague. Defaults to ASYNQ_TIMEZONE or runtime timezone.

name: familia_list_past_due
title: List past leftovers
